strings.subtitle: — Simbulali semafayela —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kuhudvuta nekushiya akukho. Sebentisa likinobho lelingaphansi.
strings.shred_button: B U L A L A
strings.ssd_warning:
Caphela! Ku-SSD, indlela yekubhala ngenhla ayincomi kubulawa ngenca ye-TRIM.
Loluhlelo lwelwa-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayela "{name}" litabhaliwa ngenhla futsi licitfwe.

Chubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Lena i-shortcut (.lnk). Kutaucitseka i-shortcut kuphela.

Ifayili leyo ikhomba kuyo itawusala ingakapheli.

Chubeka?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Lena i-network drive (\\server\share).
Kubhala kutophetseka kucitsha — iseva ingaba ne-snapshot, deduplication noma CoW.

Chubeka?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Lena i-removable drive (USB / HDD yangaphandle).
I-controller ingagcina emabhulokhi lamadzala.

Chubeka?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS imitja yedatha lehlukile (ADS) ayisebenti.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayihlantshwa.
• Emakhophi etsembu nekuhambisana kwelifu
  (OneDrive, njll.) akukhintseki.
strings.status_full: Lokucuketfwe kubhalwe ngenhla ngcobo ngemakhulu. Kukhipha akunakwentiwa — emathulusi abona makhulu kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Inhloko, umsila nemitja lengu-4 MB kubhalwe ngenhla. Lokusala akukashintjwa, kodvwa ngenca yetikhalo, kukhipha konkhe ngemathulusi elwati akunakwentiwa. Etidokhumendeni letiyimfihlo sebenzisa IMODO LEPHELELE.
strings.status_empty: Ifayela belingenalutto, kubhala ngenhla bekungadzingeki. Licitfwe.
strings.error_permission: Akukwati kufinyelela kufayili. Ingahle ivuliwe kolunye luhlelo. Vala bese uyaphindza.
strings.error_is_symlink: Lena i-symbolic link. Ema-link akakwati kucitsheka — ifayili leyo ikhomba kuyo itawusala ingakapheli.
strings.error_reparse: Lena ifayili yesikhala (OneDrive noma lefanako). Idatha yayo isesiphundwini, hhayi kudiski — akukho lokucitsheka lapha.
strings.error_not_file: Lena akuyo ifayili (ifolda noma lenye into). Beka ifayili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Lefayili inenye i-hard link ({n} inani). I-hard link ayinayo inkhulu — onkhe emabito ayalingana. Nangabe uyacitsha ngendlela yamanje, idatha itawubhalwa phezu kwalokho bese isikwa ku-32 bytes, kepha insalela itawusala ifinyeleleka ngalamanye ema-link. Sula onkhe ema-link kucala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayili icindzetelwe, ibetelwe noma i-sparse. Kubhala nge-zero akusivumeli kucitsha idatha lendzala ngoba i-NTFS iyigcina ngenye indlela.

Susa i-attribute: cindza ekudleni → Properties → Advanced → susa 'Compress' na/noma 'Encrypt'. Bese ucale SHREDDER futsi.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} emafayili atawucitseka.
Ubukhulu bako konkhe: {size}.

Hlola luhlu ngaphambi kwekuchubeka.
Lomsebenti awukakwati kuhlehliswa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Susa onkhe {count} emafayili kulayini?

Emafayili ngokwawo NGEKE atsintseka — luhlu kuphela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Ifayili "{name}" inenye i-hard link ({nlink} inani).

Idatha itawucitseka kubo bonkhe emabito.
Kepha insalela (32 bytes) itawusala ngaphansi kwelamanye emabito kufolda.

Kungahle kudzingeke kutsi ususe lensalela ngesandla.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Sebentisa kuto tonkhe i-hard link kulayini
